HELP! Eight people are trapped on the first floor of a house at
Riverbank Village. Water is still rising and the stairs are
underwater. Please send a rescue boat now. Two of us are
children.

We are stuck at home because the road is flooded, but
everyone is safe. No ambulance is needed at the moment. We

need drinking water and food packets for the family by
tomorrow morning.

AMBULANCE REQUIRED URGENTLY

A pregnant woman in North Colony is in labour, and the road to the
clinic is under water. Please send a boat ambulance and a doctor
before 9:00 PM tonight.

Road to Green Valley Cu
Fields

The only road to Green Valley has been
under waist-deep water since Tuesday,
leaving about 400 residents without access
to shops or clinics. Local volunteers say
stocks of drinking water are running low.
Off as River Floods

They have asked the control room for water
tankers, food packets, and two boats to
carry the elderly to the relief camp. The
water level is expected to stay high until
Friday.

Blankets and Warm Clothes Needed at
Sunrise Nagar Relief Camp

The relief camp at the Sunrise Nagar Community Hall is now sheltering
120 people, most of them women and children. Nights have turned cold
and many families have only wet clothes.

Camp organisers have asked donors for blankets, warm clothes and
baby clothing by Sunday. No medical help is needed, as the visiting
doctor has already examined everyone.

NOTICE: Evacuation of Eastbank Ward

All residents of Eastbank Ward must evacuate to the relief
camp at Sunrise Nagar Town Hall before 6:00 PM today.
About 350 people live in the low-lying lanes.

Buses will leave from the market ground every 30 minutes.
Elderly and disabled residents should contact the control
room for boat assistance.

Relief Distribution at Maple Lane School
Ground

Food packets, drinking water and blankets will be distributed
at Maple Lane School Ground on Saturday between 10:00
AM and 2:00 PM. One packet will be given to each family on
showing a household card.

Volunteers will deliver supplies to people who cannot walk.
Trucks carrying supplies may be delayed because two
bridges are flooded.

Seven Villagers Stranded on Rooftop at
Silverstream Hamlet

Rescue teams are racing to reach seven villagers, including a pregnant
woman and two small children, stranded on a rooftop at Silverstream
Hamlet. A landslide has blocked the access road, and the water has
reached the roof level.

The group has had no food or drinking water since Monday, and one
child has a high fever. Officials said two boats and a medical team will
leave at dawn.
